```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

Configured teams are untouched, so they still keep active and dormant members. Blank latest-commit dates already count as active in `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so no extra code was needed for that case.

The `codeanalyzer` module compiles and its tests pass offline. There were no existing tests for this class, so the new behaviour is not covered by a test. Nothing is committed.

One thing to check: `isActive()` measures the 180 days from `DateUtils.getCalendar()`, which applies the configured analysis date if one is set, and otherwise uses the current time. That matches the "analysis date" wording in the task, provided the analysis date is configured the same way as elsewhere in the code.
